title: Night Beat
paragraphs: Frank Lovejoy stars as Randy Stone, a Chicago Star reporter who walks the city after dark, following stories that move between crime, mystery, and the private lives of people he meets on his night beat.
36-recording GRH preservation subset of the larger NBC run starring Frank Lovejoy as Chicago Star night reporter Randy Stone. The collection is not complete.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: NBC Night Beat run (February 6, 1950 to September 25, 1952) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|frank-lovejoy|Frank Lovejoy]] (performer), Warren Lewis (director, producer, and writer), Frank Worth (music, composer, and conductor), Robert Armbruster (music and conductor), Larry Marcus (writer and editor), Joan Banks (performer), and [[person|william-conrad|William Conrad]] (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] and [[org|org.99a83c858631bdcc|WNBC]].

The stories often return to newspaper reporting and journalism, human-interest stories and private lives, urban night life and city streets, crime and criminal investigation, gambling and rackets, and aviation and aircraft danger.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Postwar urban newspaper drama, NBC sustaining and sponsored dramatic programming, and AFRS preservation and rediscovery.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|escape|Escape]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]], and [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]].
